g.text: PR #2329 · Compact login link actions
Long OAuth URLs made sign-in prompts hard to use.
Open the login page or copy its complete URL with one click.
BEFORE
AFTER
Raw URL in the login modal
Long OAuth query strings wrap across many lines.
The URL itself is the link label.
Copying requires manual selection
There is no dedicated clipboard action.
Small-screen prompts devote space to URL text.
LoginLinkActions
Open login is a compact link with target=_blank.
Copy link writes the complete URL to the clipboard.
Honest clipboard feedback
Copied appears only after the write succeeds.
A rejected write shows a helpful error.
Shared by both sign-in shapes
AuthUrl and DeviceCode use the same controls.
Approval polling and automatic close are unchanged.
UI only: login initiation, code submission, polling, and credentials are unchanged.
